title: The Direct line to the office
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：direct　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 direct 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1993 the porter wrote of ① a direct line to the office in the journal, and everybody in the coast said at once that it was ② more direct than the one named there the year before. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the porter, who never explained anything, had done it without complaint and gone home; it was the direct ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most direct line to the office anybody in the coast had ever seen, or so the journal for August 1987 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too direct to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the visitor who had come to help; the direct ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the bag at the far cove, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a direct answer to the question, and said that no visitor in his right mind would call it ⑥ as direct as the answer to the question they had once had in the old coast. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was direct or not, and he said so.

By 2000 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the journal. What the line asked for was ⑦ something direct, and nothing besides. The visitor from the next coast called the whole plan ⑧ quite direct; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the journal kept the names of the direct ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 2003, with great care, she wrote of another direct line to the office in the same journal, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ more direct than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most direct answer to the question in the whole coast, she said in 2005, was the one she could never quite name; the direct ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 直接（前置定语 a direct line to the office：1993 年挑夫在行记里记下的那件直接的直路）
B. adj. 直接／直率（比较级 more direct than：文中两处，一处比通往办公室的直路，一处比预想）
C. adj. 直接／直率（最高级 the most direct：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 直接（表语 too direct to do：母亲觉得它太直接，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 直率（前置定语 a direct answer to the question：叔叔把整件事称作一桩直率的回答）
F. adj. 直率（同级比较 as direct as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩直截了当的回答相比）
G. adj. 直率（后置定语 something direct：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 直率（受程度副词修饰 quite direct：那位游客的评价）

items.q: a direct line to the office
the most direct line to the office anybody
a direct answer to the question
The most direct answer to the question in

answers.why: direct 意为“直接”，1993 年挑夫在行记里记下的是“一件直接的直路”，此处作前置定语 a direct line to the office。
direct 意为“直接”，此处用比较级 more direct than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
direct 意为“直接”，行记上 八月 那行字说它是海岸里最直接的一件，故用最高级 the most direct line to the office。
direct 意为“直接”，母亲认为这件东西“太直接了，谁也用不上”，too direct to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
direct 意为“直率”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩直率的回答”，此处作前置定语 a direct answer to the question。
direct 意为“直率”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩直截了当的回答一样直率”，同级比较用 as direct as。
direct 意为“直率”，行记上那半行字要的是“直率的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something direct。
direct 意为“直率”，邻海岸来的那位游客认为这套计划“相当直率”，quite 修饰原级 direct。
direct 意为“直率”，2003 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要直率”，故用比较级 more direct than。
direct 意为“直率”，母亲 2005 年说的是“整个海岸里最直率的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most direct answer to the question。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1993 年，挑夫在行记里记下了一件直接的直路。（a direct line to the office）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更直接。（more direct than …）
母亲觉得它太直接，谁也用不上。（too direct to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩直率的回答。（a direct answer to the question）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩直截了当的回答一样直率。（as direct as …）
到了 2000 年，行记上只剩半行字：要的是一件直率的东西。（something direct）
answers: In 1993 the porter wrote of a direct line to the office in the journal.
Everybody said it was more direct than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too direct to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a direct answer to the question.
He said nobody would call it as direct as the answer to the question they had once had.
By 2000 the journal asked for nothing but something direct.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 direct 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1993 the porter wrote of a direct line to the office in the journal, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most direct line to the office in the coast, or so the journal says.
My mother thought it too direct to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a direct answer to the question, and nobody argued with him.
The visitor from the next coast called the plan quite direct, and everybody laughed.
The direct ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
